name: CreateExpressCloudConnection

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Express Cloud Connection instance
parameters.help_zh: 高速上云服务实例所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Express Cloud Connection instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
高速上云服务的实例名称。

长度为 2-128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，点号（.），下划线（_）和短横线（-），但不能以`http:// `或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the Express Cloud Connection instance.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character, but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
高速上云服务的描述信息。

长度为 2-256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The city where the on-premises IDC is located
parameters.name: peer_city

parameters.example: **市**区/县**路**号**物业或楼宇名称**座**楼层**房间号**机柜号**机柜名称**设备**端口
parameters.help_en:
The geographic location of the on-premises data center.

The location must be accurate to the street number, floor, room number, and rack number
parameters.help_zh:
本地数据中心的地理位置。

需要精确到门牌号码-楼层-房间号-机柜号
parameters.name: peer_location

parameters.help_en: The network service provider of the IDC
parameters.name: idc_sp

parameters.help_en:
The port type of the Express Connect circuit. Valid values:

100Base-T: 100M Ethernet port

1000Base-T (default): GE electrical port

1000Base-LX: GE single-mode optical port (10 km)

10GBase-T: 10 GE electrical port

10GBase-LR: 10 GE single-mode optical port (10 km)
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线接入端口类型，取值：

100Base-T：百兆电口

1000Base-T（默认值）：千兆电口

1000Base-LX：千兆单模光口（10千米）

10GBase-T：万兆电口

10GBase-LR：万兆单模光口（10千米）
parameters.name: port_type

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth of the Express Cloud Connection instance, which corresponds to the bandwidth of the underlying physical connection.

Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh:
申请高速上云服务的带宽，对应底层物理线路的带宽。

单位：Mbps
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the contact person for the Express Cloud Connection application
parameters.help_zh: 申请高速上云服务的联系人电话
parameters.name: contact_tel

parameters.help_en: The email address of the contact person for the Express Cloud Connection application
parameters.help_zh: 申请高速上云连接的联系人邮件
parameters.name: contact_mail

parameters.help_en: The ID card number of the contact person for the Express Cloud Connection application
parameters.help_zh: 申请高速上云服务的联系人证件证号
parameters.name: id_card_no

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the redundant Express Cloud Connection circuit
parameters.help_zh: 冗余高速上云服务专线实例ID
parameters.name: redundant_ecc_id
